title: Bounded contexts, write ownership and the schema for twelve universities
scenario: Kestrel grows from one pilot university to twelve. The Spring Boot catalog API is a shared tangle, every feature asks for a microservice, generated drafts once leaked to learners, quiz attempts grow 6M rows a month, transcripts are not stored and three universities need logically isolated data. Write the design document for the architecture review.
task: Ubiquitous language, bounded contexts and a context map
Aggregates, invariants and write ownership; events with an outbox
Modular monolith with Spring Modulith vs separate services, with reasons
Schema, partitioning, analytics, tenancy, retention and a migration path
acceptance: Rubric-graded (0/0 tests): decisions tied to the constraints
Concrete tables, constraints and indexes with named queries

practices.label: Week 7 Mon - DDD and bounded contexts
Week 7 Tue - Spring Modulith and service boundaries
Week 7 Wed - schema design, partitioning and tenancy
